intent: Feature signal store. Injects RoutinesApi and ToastStore. load(routineId) fetches steps+phases (forkJoin) and selects the first step; completeStep shows toast `Step ${stepNumber} completed` ('success'); advancePhase sets phaseFeedback ('Advanced to STEP NN') and a toast; selectedStep is computed from selectedStepId. Contracts: RoutinesApi (providedIn root) { getSteps(routineId: string): Observable<WorkoutStep[]>; completeStep(routineId: string, stepId: string): Observable<WorkoutStep>; getPhases(): Observable<PhaseProgress[]>; advancePhase(): Observable<PhaseProgress[]> } ; ToastStore (providedIn root) { readonly toasts: Signal<readonly Notification[]>; show(message: string, severity: ToastSeverity): string; dismiss(id: string): void; clear(): void }. Public API exactly: RoutinesStore (providedIn root) { readonly steps: Signal<readonly WorkoutStep[]>; readonly phases: Signal<readonly PhaseProgress[]>; readonly selectedStep: Signal<WorkoutStep | null>; readonly phaseFeedback: Signal<string | null>; readonly loading: Signal<boolean>; readonly error: Signal<string | null>; load(routineId: string): void; selectStep(stepId: string): void; completeStep(stepId: string): void; advancePhase(): void }.
